baseline.description: Accepted W006 reference path on non-production/local runner semantics with SQLite-backed reference persistence.
baseline.purpose: Counterfactual semantic floor and regression control only.
disqualifiers: No representative multi-replica shared production database/event substrate.

components.database: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, regional HA, PITR enabled
components.object_storage: Cloud Storage private bucket(s), quarantine/accepted separation
components.secrets: Secret Manager direct API with version-pinned access
components.identity: separate Google Cloud service identities with least-privilege IAM
components.observability: OTLP-compatible OpenTelemetry Collector sidecar or dedicated collector service
components.deployment: immutable image digest + declarative IaC + Cloud Run revisions

candidates.material_difference: Request-driven serverless service plus managed continuous worker-pool revision model; platform manages serving infrastructure and request autoscaling.
qualification_notes: Cloud Run worker pools do not autoscale; T002 must predeclare and measure worker count/scaling procedure rather than infer parity with service autoscaling.
Long-running workflow execution must not depend on a single request lifetime.
All correctness state must live outside ephemeral container filesystems.

components.request_surface: ECS Fargate service behind Application Load Balancer
components.database: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ, automated backups/PITR enabled
components.object_storage: Amazon S3 private bucket(s), quarantine/accepted separation
components.identity: separate ECS task role and task execution role with least privilege
components.deployment: immutable image digest + declarative IaC + ECS rolling deployment circuit breaker or predeclared blue/green path

candidates.material_difference: Explicit desired-count long-lived task scheduler with load balancer and service deployment controller; no request-serverless execution model.
qualification_notes: Deployment rollback mode must be fixed before outcome collection and actually exercised.
Task and execution roles must remain distinct in security tests.
All topology-specific networking and service-discovery assumptions must be captured as raw evidence.

components.background_workers: separate GKE Autopilot Deployment for workers
components.database: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, regional HA, PITR enabled
components.object_storage: Cloud Storage private bucket(s), quarantine/accepted separation
components.secrets: Secret Manager via Workload Identity Federation
components.identity: Kubernetes ServiceAccounts mapped through Workload Identity Federation
components.observability: OTLP-compatible OpenTelemetry Collector sidecar or Deployment
components.deployment: immutable image digest + Kubernetes manifests/IaC + rolling Deployment, probes, PDB, HPA

candidates.material_difference: Kubernetes pod/controller/HPA/PDB control model exposes a materially larger scheduling, rollout and workload-identity surface than the serverless and managed-task alternatives.
qualification_notes: Autopilot Workload Identity Federation is always enabled; use it instead of static cloud credentials.
Readiness/startup/liveness probes and disruption policy are qualification surfaces, not documentation-only claims.
Operational burden must be measured, not presumed from Kubernetes flexibility.

runtime_challenger_policy.production_rule: No runtime framework is locked by T001. T002 must bind eligible runtime candidates to representative PostgreSQL-backed topology where supported and preserve the accepted W006 state/event acceptance contract.
runtime_challenger_policy.temporal_trigger: Execute a Temporal challenger only if a remaining durability/operations hypothesis can plausibly alter hard-gate eligibility or Pareto membership after the minimum runtime set is tested on representative deployed topology.

cross_candidate_controls: Same immutable application image digest and frozen Python 3.13.15 + uv 0.12.18 toolchain.
Same exact 3 audiences x 3 formats identities and versioned input corpus.
Same authoritative state/event acceptance contract and hard-gate semantics.
Same predeclared target geography where comparable; record region/provider mismatch as a confounder.
Same topology-benchmark provider-effect proxy/configuration; provider/model winner is out of scope and remains for W007-T006.
Same OTLP semantic surface and evidence schema.
Candidate execution order randomized or rotated for repeated windows.

decision_rule.lock_condition: A production lock is permitted only after T002 representative deployed execution if every required hard gate passes, required objectives are observed, no material candidate is unevaluated without an evidence-backed exclusion, and the decision remains supported under uncertainty/repetition. Otherwise emit NO_PREFERENCE or PENDING_EVIDENCE.
